_comment: LBC/USDT accumulation (MEXC spot) — ⚠ REAL MONEY, the only live bot in the fleet; see _live_note. Same v2.0 accumulation engine as btc_accumulation_mexc, adapted for the sub-cent alt LBCUSDT. Price/OBI come from a dedicated MEXC-spot scalping stream (lbc_scalping_mexc, sourced from the shared cex_feed mexc:LBCUSDT) that the bot self-registers with the indicators service over TCP 5561 (proven to work cross-account, same host). The BTC-specific macro gates (liquidations, L/S ratio, 4h-RSI, macro-OBI, Fear&Greed) are DISABLED — they are Bitcoin-market signals that do not apply to LBC; accumulation is driven by LBC's own OBI + VWAP only.
_band_note: The requested 0.001–0.0025 range is not a hard bound (the accumulation engine has no lower/upper band like the grid). It emerges from behaviour: dip-buying pulls entries down toward ~0.001 and the profit bands (+5..+50% from a ~0.0021 avg entry, i.e. up to ~0.00253) take profit as price rises toward 0.0025.
_bamm_note: BAMM = Bullish Accumulating Market Maker: fixed-rung two-sided maker, downside-weighted, floored at 0.001, keeps 10% of every buy as permanent stash. grid_top pinned for stable rungs across restarts. grid_budget_usdt is only the SIZING split across the geometric ladder — placement is gated by the bot's own free_usdt (persisted, not this file), which by 2026-07-25 already covers every geometric rung (confirmed: real MEXC balance free=$92.62 well beyond the resting book). The '$150 top-up' framing is stale — treat grid_budget_usdt as sizing-only, not a live funding gate.
_extra_rungs_note: extra_buy_rungs (2026-07-25, operator request): two manual $10 fixed rungs placed OUTSIDE the geometric lattice, at operator-chosen prices in the gap between the resting 0.0022806 bid and the 0.0024007 ask — NOT derived from grid_step_pct (0.00237/0.00247 are ~4.05% apart, not the ladder's 5%). Funded by a $20 USDT deposit (capital_usdt 100->120). Same bid->ask->rebuy cycle as any other rung once added.
_live_note: REAL MONEY, ARMED. Buy-only accumulation (Option B): live_execution routes buys to real MEXC maker resting bids, credited only on actual fill. Clips are tiny ($10 initial / $5 dip-adds; both validated via order/test — minNotional is 1 USDT) vs the thin book. Exposure is capped at ONE resting clip at a time (the pending_buy guard), budget $100 tracked internally. Requires EnvironmentFile=~/.config/tradinebotte/mexc7.env + TRADINEBOTTE_IPV4_ONLY=1 on the unit; without the key the connector fail-safes to paper. Buy-only: profit-band sells + rebuys are skipped when live_execution=true — we never sell into the ~$27/10% bid book. Set shadow=true to disarm back to logging-only.
_ladder_note: Ratchet ladder: resting post-only SELLs at +5%/+10% ABOVE AVG_ENTRY (not per-tranche — per-tranche anchoring sells the cheapest coins first and ratchets the cost basis up). 30%+30% of holdings, floored at 40% of peak (min_holdings_pct) so a core position is never sold. Each sell FILL mints a rebuy obligation 3% under the fill price, so every round trip returns MORE coins than it sold — that is the ratchet. Ceiling 0.02: above it we stop trimming and let the breakout run. Sells are LIMIT_MAKER (post-only): MEXC auto-cancels rather than let us cross, so a fill is always 0-fee maker.
_paper_bands_note: profit_bands_pct/sell_fraction drive the PAPER reactive path only; live uses sell_ladder above. min_holdings_pct is shared and load-bearing for both: it is the ratchet floor. 0.40 = the ladder's 30%+30% can sell at most 60% of peak holdings, and the last 40% is never sold by any path.
